title: Tip a balanced ruler
description: Balance a ruler and move a small weight until it tips, then say where the weight was.
oneStarDescription: Balance the ruler on a finger or a pencil.
twoStarDescription: Move one coin until the ruler tips, and mark that place.
threeStarDescription: Move the coin back and show the ruler balances again.

title: Trace a crack you will not fill
description: Trace the path of a crack on a note or a photo, and do not fill it.
oneStarDescription: Draw the crack's path on a copy or a note.
twoStarDescription: Mark where you can see it start and stop.
threeStarDescription: Write that you did not fill, glue, or paint it.

title: Try the step on a new case
description: Give a new example and see whether the learner uses the same step.
oneStarDescription: Finish one example together.
twoStarDescription: Give a new case that needs the same step.
threeStarDescription: Say whether they used the step, and where the new case differed.

title: Turn a headline into a question
description: Turn a headline into a question the article might answer, then see whether it does.
oneStarDescription: Rewrite the headline as one question.
twoStarDescription: Point to the sentence that answers it, or write that the piece does not.
threeStarDescription: If the piece answers a different question, write that question instead.

title: Undo the last change
description: Undo the last change on a practice page or file and show the previous state.
oneStarDescription: Make one change you can reverse.
twoStarDescription: Reverse that change only.
threeStarDescription: Show the page or file as it was.

title: Use one color for the change
description: Use one color only for the thing that changed, and leave the rest in one other treatment.
oneStarDescription: Pick one color and write what it means.
twoStarDescription: Use it only on the change.
threeStarDescription: Ask someone what the color means, without telling them first.

title: Watch a cloud shadow cross
description: Watch a cloud shadow cross the ground and say which way it went.
oneStarDescription: Point to a shadow on the ground, not at the sun.
twoStarDescription: Say which landmark it moved toward.
threeStarDescription: Write the time and the landmark.

title: Watch a salt solution
description: Leave a small salt solution and describe what you see the next day, without claiming a yield.
oneStarDescription: Dissolve salt in a little water in a shallow dish and write the start.
twoStarDescription: Describe what you see, including if you see nothing new.
threeStarDescription: Write that you are not claiming a measured amount.

title: Watch them do the next step
description: Stop an explanation and let the learner do the next step while you watch.
oneStarDescription: Stop before the last step.
twoStarDescription: Watch them do it without taking over.
threeStarDescription: Write the one hint you gave, or that you gave none.

title: Watch water appear on a glass
description: Watch a cold glass and say where water appeared on the outside.
oneStarDescription: Use a cold drink and note the outside is dry at the start, or say it is not.
twoStarDescription: Point to where water appears, and say whether it came from inside the glass.
threeStarDescription: Put a room-temperature glass beside it and say which one stays dry.

title: Wax a thread and sew an inch
description: Wax a short thread and sew one inch so the thread does not tangle.
oneStarDescription: Draw the thread across wax once.
twoStarDescription: Sew a short line on scrap cloth.
threeStarDescription: Say whether it tangled less than an unwaxed end you tried.

title: Weigh two shapes of the same clay
description: Shape the same piece of clay two ways and say whether the scale number stayed the same.
oneStarDescription: Weigh one shape and write the number.
twoStarDescription: Reshape that same clay and weigh it again.
threeStarDescription: Say that you did not add or remove clay, or note if you did.

title: Write a claim you can check
description: Write one sentence another person can check, and name where they would look.
oneStarDescription: Write one claim in a sentence that names what would count as true.
twoStarDescription: Add the page, object, or person a checker should use, or write that you have no place yet.
threeStarDescription: Ask someone to say whether they could check it, and revise the sentence if they cannot.

title: Write a hint that points
description: Write a hint that says where to look, not the answer.
oneStarDescription: Write where to look or which step to retry.
twoStarDescription: Read it and remove any word that gives the result.
threeStarDescription: Give it to someone who is stuck and see whether they move without the answer.

title: Write a margin question
description: Write a question in the margin of your own copy, then try to answer it later.
oneStarDescription: Write one question beside the passage on your copy or a note.
twoStarDescription: Read on before you answer.
threeStarDescription: Later, answer it or write that the passage did not.

title: Write a question for the meeting
description: Write one question you could ask at a public meeting, and what answer would help.
oneStarDescription: Write one question in one or two sentences.
twoStarDescription: Write what kind of answer would help you act.
threeStarDescription: Say whether the question matches an item on the agenda, or that you have not seen the agenda.

title: Write a run of show
description: Write the start, one middle point, and the end time for a small gathering.
oneStarDescription: Write when it starts and what the first action is.
twoStarDescription: Write one middle point and who is responsible.
threeStarDescription: Write the end time where a newcomer could read it.

title: Write what done looks like
description: Write the visible sign of done before you start a small task.
oneStarDescription: Write what you will see when it is done.
twoStarDescription: Do the task you defined before you started.
threeStarDescription: Point to the sign, or say it is not done yet.

title: Write the limit first
description: Write the one limit on a task, then do the task inside it.
oneStarDescription: Write the time, the material, or the rule before you start.
twoStarDescription: Do the task without crossing the limit.
threeStarDescription: If you hit the limit, stop and write what is unfinished.

title: Write the owner of the decision
description: Write the decision and the one person who will carry it.
oneStarDescription: Write what was decided in one sentence.
twoStarDescription: Write one name, and check they accept it.
threeStarDescription: Write what others will see when it is done.

title: Write the question before you search
description: Write the question on paper before you open a search.
oneStarDescription: Write one question you can finish.
twoStarDescription: Search only for that question.
threeStarDescription: Write the answer with where you found it, or write that you did not find it.

title: Write the question that returned
description: When a learner asks the same question again, stop and write that question down.
oneStarDescription: Point to the question the second time it appears.
twoStarDescription: Write it in their words.
threeStarDescription: Answer it in a different way, or say you need to learn it first.

title: Write the speaking order
description: Write the order of three speakers and the sentence that hands the turn on.
oneStarDescription: Write three names in order.
twoStarDescription: Write the sentence the current speaker will use to pass the turn.
threeStarDescription: Use that sentence once and note whether the next person knew it was their turn.

title: Write the step in their words
description: Ask the learner to say the step, and write it in their words.
oneStarDescription: Let them describe the step before you rewrite it.
twoStarDescription: Write what they said, not your preferred sentence.
threeStarDescription: Add one missing piece only if they agree it was missing.

title: Write the time back
description: After you agree a time, write it back and ask the other person to correct it.
oneStarDescription: Write the day and time in the form you both used.
twoStarDescription: Ask them to change it if it is wrong.
threeStarDescription: Keep their confirmation or their change with the note.

title: Write the version on the page
description: Write a version mark on a page and say what changed from the previous one.
oneStarDescription: Write a version such as first or second on the page.
twoStarDescription: Write one thing that changed.
threeStarDescription: Show the earlier page still exists.

title: Write what a late person needs
description: Write the one sentence a person who arrives late needs in order to join.
oneStarDescription: Write where to sit, what is happening, and who to ask.
twoStarDescription: Place the note at the entrance you named.
threeStarDescription: Ask someone who missed the start whether the note was enough, or test it yourself.

title: Write what would change your mind
description: Write one observation that would make you drop a claim you currently hold.
oneStarDescription: Write the claim in one sentence.
twoStarDescription: Write one thing you could see or read that would make you drop it.
threeStarDescription: Ask whether someone else could see that thing, and rewrite it if they could not.

title: Write what you did not change
description: Write three lines: what changed, why, and what you left alone.
oneStarDescription: Name the change in one line.
twoStarDescription: Write the reason in one line.
threeStarDescription: Name one part you did not change.

title: Write what you will not do
description: Write what you will not do, in one sentence the other person can repeat.
oneStarDescription: Write one boundary as an action you will not take.
twoStarDescription: Ask them to say it back.
threeStarDescription: If you are about to cross it, stop and point to the sentence.

title: Write when you will check again
description: Write when you will look at a task again, and what will count as done.
oneStarDescription: Write the day or the event that triggers the check.
twoStarDescription: Write the visible sign of done.
threeStarDescription: At that time, write whether it is done.

title: Write where you go if it rains
description: Write in one sentence where the group goes if it rains, and how they will know.
oneStarDescription: Write the indoor or covered place.
twoStarDescription: Write who decides and how people hear it.
threeStarDescription: Confirm the backup place is available, or write that you have not checked.

title: Add two numbers on an abacus
description: Add two small numbers on an abacus and check the sum in writing.
oneStarDescription: Set the first number and say it.
twoStarDescription: Add the second number on the abacus.
threeStarDescription: Write the sum and compare it with the abacus.

title: Align two mirrors to see behind you
description: Hold two mirrors so you can see something behind you.
oneStarDescription: Point to what one mirror shows.
twoStarDescription: Angle the second so you see behind you.
threeStarDescription: Name the object behind you that you could not see directly.

title: Ask for a water refill
description: Ask for a refill of a bottle you already have, and stop if the answer is no.
oneStarDescription: Show the bottle you want filled.
twoStarDescription: Ask once, in a sentence.
threeStarDescription: If the answer is no, thank them and stop.

title: Balance a card on a finger
description: Balance a card on one finger long enough to show, then catch it.
oneStarDescription: Rest the card and find a still point.
twoStarDescription: Hold it still long enough to be seen.
threeStarDescription: Catch the card when it tips.

title: Balance a fork and explain it
description: Balance a fork and spoon or a fork on a glass using a match or a toothpick setup you can explain.
oneStarDescription: Put the pieces together.
twoStarDescription: Set it on the glass so it stays.
threeStarDescription: Point to where the weight sits.

title: Balance a stick on a finger
description: Balance a light stick upright on one finger for a moment you can show.
oneStarDescription: Rest the stick and find where it stays.
twoStarDescription: Keep it up long enough for someone to see.
threeStarDescription: Take one step and say whether it stayed.

title: Bead a repeating pattern
description: String a bead pattern of three colors that repeats, and read the pattern back.
oneStarDescription: Write the three-color order.
twoStarDescription: String at least two repeats.
threeStarDescription: Read the colors aloud and stop at a mistake.

title: Beatbox a kick and a snare
description: Make two different mouth sounds, one for a kick and one for a snare, and alternate them.
oneStarDescription: Make one low sound and name it the kick.
twoStarDescription: Make a different sound and name it the snare.
threeStarDescription: Alternate them so a listener can point to each.
